title: New independent contractor paperwork request
use_when: Use when a business starts paying a worker it has already determined is an independent contractor; use the new-hire list for employees.
note: Items follow the IRS pages on independent contractors and Form W-9 with its requester instructions. Whether the worker is a contractor or an employee is not decided by this list, and state requirements are not covered.

irs-reporting.name: IRS, Reporting payments to independent contractors (page last reviewed or updated 22-May-2026)

situations.foreign: Is the contractor a foreign person?
situations.tin-notice: Has the IRS notified the payer that the contractor's taxpayer identification number is incorrect?

items.label: Completed and signed Form W-9
items.detail: The IRS says to keep the W-9 in your files for four years. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Name as shown on the contractor's tax return, and business name if different
Federal tax classification (individual/sole proprietor, C corporation, S corporation, partnership, trust/estate, LLC or other)
Taxpayer identification number: Social Security number or employer identification number
items.detail: Form W-9 Part I. The IRS page says the payer must withhold 24% (backup withholding) if the TIN is not provided in the manner required. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Form W-8 or Form 8233 instead of Form W-9
items.detail: The W-9 requester instructions say to advise foreign persons to use the appropriate Form W-8 or Form 8233. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Certified taxpayer identification number as required in the IRS notice
items.detail: The IRS page says backup withholding at 24% applies if the payee does not certify their TIN as required in the notice. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

sections.name: From the business paying the contractor

items.label: Payments made to the contractor for services during the tax year
items.detail: Used for Form 1099-NEC, which reports payments totaling or exceeding the reportable payment threshold amount.
